project.name: Catalyst Economic Leverage
project.role: negative control (rank-preservation reaction) for the NH3-FINAL-1.1 inversion result
project.scientific_scope: Direct catalytic N2O decomposition (2 N2O -> 2 N2 + O2) in nitric-acid-plant tail gas, tertiary position, once-through fixed bed, no recycle, no separation, no purge. Catalyst activity enters the economics only through catalyst inventory (metal mass, bed volume, vessel) and through the operating temperature needed to reach the fixed conversion target (heating duty, pressure drop). All numbers in `kinetics` and `descriptor` are declared reconstruction values (see NEGATIVE_CONTROL_V0_1_PREREGISTRATION.md, section 3); nothing in this file is inherited from, or feeds back into, configs/nh3_final.yaml.

monte_carlo.seed_note: per-worker streams seed + k*1000003, 8 workers; draw order not identical to a single-stream run
